sections.changelog: v1.2.105: Media Studio attachment details now show file type beside dimensions and size. Plugin Studio now cleanly switches between installed-plugin filters and Plugin Directory, with aligned grid/list directory cards. Content Studio now ignores stale list responses when switching types, resets row state on navigation, and uses server-provided edit/Bricks links. Builder Tools floating panels are clamped inside the viewport, and dragging Elements no longer moves the Structure shortcut rail.
